metering.reason: Meter baseline login returned HTTP 401; generation stopped before provider usage was recorded.

failure_chain: Runner assembled the workspace and completed environment preflight.
The platform invoked the uploaded main.py with the expected requirement and output arguments.
The agent emitted masked environment information and reached its API probe.
The probe received HTTP 401 and classified it as a permanent authentication failure.
main.py exited with code 2 before generation, Evolution planning, code generation, acceptance, or Playwright.
The platform marked start_agent failed; run_tests remained not reached and the container was removed.

root_cause_candidates.candidate: The platform-injected credential was rejected by the API authentication layer, or the platform auth context was unauthorized at this time.
evidence: Raw generation log reports HTTP 401 from the agent API probe.
The agent environment reports OPENAI_API_KEY=set, but that only proves presence, not validity.
The same run records meter baseline login failure with HTTP 401.
root_cause_candidates.limits: The secret value and server-side authentication reason are unavailable and must not be recovered into logs.

root_cause_candidates.candidate: The agent's direct pre-generation probe is the fail-fast enforcement point, so an auth error prevents all business generation.
evidence: The run log shows the probe immediately before exit code 2.
Static code places probe_endpoint() before requirement loading and Flow.run().
root_cause_candidates.limits: This explains the failure path, not why the platform credential was rejected.

root_cause_candidates.candidate: A model or endpoint configuration mismatch caused the upstream rejection.
evidence: The model and base URL are present in the runner environment.
root_cause_candidates.limits: The observed status is 401, and the run does not expose the request body or server response body; there is insufficient evidence to attribute the rejection to model selection or URL shape.

stage5_routing.decision: Route to Stage 5 as a platform/authentication gate, not as a business-code optimization candidate.
allowed_future_boundary: Fix platform/submission credential authorization outside the Agent code if the auth audit confirms an invalid or expired credential.
If a code change is later justified, only improve authentication failure classification, masked diagnostics, and bounded preflight behavior.
Do not bypass HTTP 401, silently continue with an unauthenticated client, or change official tests, requirements, assets, or business-generation logic based on this Run.
stage5_routing.go_no_go: Do not use this Run to tune completion, Token, or application correctness. Require a later valid run that reaches generation and /workspace/tests before functional optimization.
